"'''The Wolf'''" was the nickname of a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]].
==Biography==
A [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], known as "The Wolf", lived during the period of [[Time/Legends|time]] marked by the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" /> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3641 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> he was present on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in the region known as the [[Glacial Fissure]], near the Republic's [[Outpost Senth]], in an area heavily populated by [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]] and [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]]. The Cathar parked a [[Unidentified speeder van model|speeder van]] under an ice serac, near the body of a [[Death/Legends|dead]] tauntaun. He took out his security chest, set up a fire heater and prepared two [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
During that time, an individual came across the Wolf. The Wolf attacked them but was defeated and killed in the skirmish.<ref name="SWTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
The Wolf was tall, with [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], brown [[Hair/Legends|fur]] covering his body, and a number of dark marks on his face.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Skills and abilities==
A proficient [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]], the Cathar wielded his [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] to great effect, using both standard fire and more well-aimed, concentrated shots. He was also able to fire heavy explosive rounds from his weapon, and he used other tools at his disposal, including [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. In emergency situations, the Wolf was able to emit an energy discharge, knocking his enemies a short distance away.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Equipment==
During his time on Hoth, the Wolf wore a set of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and was armed with a sniper [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]], which fired armor-piercing charges. He also carried a number of grenades, including [[thermal grenade]]s that exploded on impact, as well as [[Sticky grenade/Legends|sticky grenades]] that attached to the enemy and detonated a few [[Standard second|seconds]] later. His armor was equipped with a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]], which the Wolf used to drag his opponents to him. The Cathar was also equipped with a [[Personal energy shield/Legends|device]] that projected a defensive [[Deflector shield/Legends|energy field]] around him, offering additional protection from enemy attacks.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wolf first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a "Champion"&ndash;type boss on Hoth. He is not directly involved in any quests but can be killed for loot, both directly from the boss, as well as a security chest that periodically spawns near his location. This article assumes 100 percent game completion, which means he was killed. However, since Hoth is a planet open to both factions of the game, it is unknown if he was killed by a Republic or an Imperial character.<ref name="SWTOR" />

The Wolf was originally designed as a Level 40 boss.<ref name="SWTOR" /> However, with the release of Game Update 2.0 and the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel|''Rise of the Hutt Cartel'' expansion]], the area in which the Wolf was located was converted into a dig site for a Level 55 side activity involving the [[Seeker Droid|subterranean seeker droids]] introduced in the expansion. All the non-player characters in the area&mdash;the tauntauns, wampas, and the Wolf himself&mdash;were subsequently upscaled to Level 55, significantly increasing their health and damage output. However, the loot rewards for killing them were unchanged. The expansion also notably introduced the achievement system into the game, with a number of achievements on most planets that involved killing uniquely named boss opponents who were not related to any quests. However, the Wolf was not included as part of any achievement,<ref name="RotHC">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref> nor was he mentioned in any ''The Old Republic''&ndash;related supplementary material.<ref name="SWTOR" />
